question.problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $15?$

I. ${R}^{14}$

II. ${\text{M}}_{3\times 5}(R),$ the vector space of all $3\times 5$ matrices over $R$

III. ${R}_{14}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $14$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

I. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}^{n})=n.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}^{14})=14\ne 15.\,\times 
  $$

II. Recall that $\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{n\times m}(R))=n\cdot m.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({\text{M}}_{3\times 5}(R))=3\cdot 5=15.\,✓
  $$

III. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}_{14}[t])=14+1=15.\,✓
  $$

Hence, the correct answer is "II and III only."
